slides.headline: You, as a text file.
slides.supportingLine: Health.md reads Health Connect and writes your days as Markdown, CSV and JSON files you own.

slides.headline: Interrogate your own body.
slides.supportingLine: Hand your health files to the AI and tools you already use, by folder, CLI or API.

slides.headline: The periodic table of you.
slides.supportingLine: Pick exactly which metrics get written: sleep, heart, activity, vitals, nutrition and more.

slides.headline: Your day, itemized.
slides.supportingLine: A daily note lands in your vault on the schedule you set. You just read it.

slides.headline: Pin your sleep for closer study.
slides.supportingLine: Every sleep stage Health Connect records, saved as a file you can compare to the last hundred.

slides.headline: Your month, as a quilt.
slides.supportingLine: The Archive shows every day you’ve exported, and flags the gaps worth filling.

slides.headline: Preserved on your own devices.
slides.supportingLine: Health Connect data goes from your phone straight to your files. Nothing passes through a Health.md cloud.

slides.headline: Your numbers, at a glance.
slides.supportingLine: Home screen widgets for your archive, activity, heart and sleep.
